Approach

How an engagement works

01

Exposure review

We start with how the business actually runs — operations, contracts, payroll, fleet, property — and find where the exposure really sits before anyone talks about premium.

02

Market access

As an independent agency we place through national carriers and wholesale markets, so the structure follows the risk instead of whatever one carrier happens to sell.

03

Ongoing advocacy

Renewals get worked ahead of the date rather than on it, and when a claim comes we handle the carrier side of it for you.

About

An operator's agency

Stonework Risk is an independent insurance agency in Dallas, led by Kris Gardner. Kris runs other operating companies alongside the agency, so he has bought these policies as a client before selling them as a broker, and he reads a schedule of coverage the way an owner does — looking for what happens on the worst day.

Independent means no quota and no house carrier. We are paid to place the right structure, which includes telling you when your current program is already the right one.

Kris Gardner · Principal
